title: EntityTypeInfo
description: NGSI-LD EntityTypeInfo data type (ETSI GS CIM 009 clause 5.2.26). The detailed entity type information representation returned by GET /types/{type} (clause 4.5.12). Not subject to options=concise/keyValues.

id.description: Fully Qualified Name (FQN) of the entity type being described.

type.description: JSON-LD @type. It shall be equal to "EntityTypeInfo".

typeName.description: Name of the entity type; short name if contained in @context.

entityCount.description: Number of entity instances of this entity type.

attributeDetails.description: List of attributes that entity instances with the specified entity type can have. Each item is an Attribute restricted to the members id, type, attributeName and attributeTypes.
